# Le Clos de la Voilerie

Le Clos de la Voilerie is a small independent residence of holiday apartments facing the estuary of the Goyen, between Plouhinec and Audierne in Finistère, Brittany, France.

Canonical site: https://leclosdelavoilerie.com/
Language currently published: French (fr-FR). English and German sections are reserved for future translation.
Direct booking is preferred via contact@leclosdelavoilerie.com.

## Main pages
- Homepage: https://leclosdelavoilerie.com/
- Apartment: Un jardin sur la mer — https://leclosdelavoilerie.com/un-jardin-sur-la-mer.html
- Apartment: Un balcon sur la mer — https://leclosdelavoilerie.com/un-balcon-sur-la-mer.html
- Apartment: Le refuge sous les toits — https://leclosdelavoilerie.com/refuge-sous-les-toits.html

## Property positioning
- Boutique coastal residence with three holiday apartments currently promoted on the site.
- Located facing the port/estuary near Audierne, Cap Sizun and the GR34 coastal path.
- Editorial tone: slow travel, sea views, tides, light, authentic Brittany, direct relationship with hosts.
- Primary conversion: direct booking request, not Airbnb.

## Apartment summaries
- Un jardin sur la mer: ground-level feel, garden/terrace, indoor-outdoor living, family-friendly, view toward the port and estuary.
- Un balcon sur la mer: balcony and open port view, light, tides, suitable for couples, families or calm remote work.
- Le refuge sous les toits: compact cocoon under the Breton roofs, Velux light, intimate atmosphere, ideal for couples or a quiet escape.
